IDENTIFICATION DIVISION.
       PROGRAM-ID. S.
       ENVIRONMENT DIVISION.
       INPUT-OUTPUT SECTION.
       FILE-CONTROL.
           SELECT F ASSIGN TO"/etc/hosts"
           ORGANIZATION IS LINE SEQUENTIAL.
       DATA DIVISION.
       FILE SECTION.
       FD F.
       01 REC PIC X(4096).
       PROCEDURE DIVISION.
           OPEN OUTPUT F.
           MOVE "x" TO REC.
           WRITE REC.
           CLOSE F.
           STOP RUN.
